threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: Trying to pay for your latte with a card and not knowing you might as well be offering gold dust here in Dalston.
Last night on the 196, a guy serenaded the entire bus with opera. Even the drunks stopped arguing to listen—surreal Brixton moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a kid selling homemade lemonade on the corner, and the customers were all adults happily paying €2. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you stumble upon a street party that turns a quiet courtyard into a vibrant art gallery, complete with local DJs and eclectic food stalls.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can spot a BART train delay by the way the crowd shuffles at 16th St. Station.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a chicken costume trying to board the 38. Muni driver shook his head and the dude just waved. Only in San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals are sipping wine at plaza del Sol, but most of us are just trying to escape the crowds and enjoy a quiet moment at home.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their baffled expressions at the slow pace of the metro during rush hour, still expecting it to run like clockwork.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus in the rain instead of checking the Overground app. It's like picking a fight with the weather.
Caught the 59 late last night, a guy in a full dinosaur costume singing to himself. Only in Brixton would that seem normal.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw a guy in a full suit casually picking up a döner at 3 a.m., like it was the most normal thing in the world.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a currywurst at 3 AM from a stand where the chef looks like he just stepped out of a Berlin film. It's an experience.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can casually name the BART line that just delayed them, while others are still figuring out what BART is.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught an overheated bus idling on Hyde, driver waiting for a coolant check while panhandlers offered snacks to the passengers. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but it's the tiny plaça with a bar named after a 70s film that really captures the soul of the place.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they awkwardly order a café amb llet – it's either too milky or too strong. The locals know the perfect balance.
